name: FAN★SERVICE
source: At the suggestion of film club president Markaven, film club member Rumi Adagio must convince three boys into being exploited to save the dying newsletter club with a magazine—a fan service magazine.
translation: 在电影社社长马卡文的提议下，社员露米·阿达吉奥必须说服三个男孩接受一场利用他们的企划，制作一本粉丝福利杂志，来拯救濒临消亡的校刊社。
